branches.title: Request qualified precursor preparation
branches.design_note: Facility owns all powder, solvent, gas and thermal processing. No masses, gas ratios or furnace program are inferred.

branches.title: Receive qualified glass production
branches.design_note: Laser levitation and atmosphere control are inaccessible service internals.

branches.title: Link composition and dryness evidence
branches.design_note: Nominally dry means no reported OH bands at an unspecified detection limit, not zero water.

branches.title: Receive MA-5 precursor assemblage
branches.design_note: Closed facility synthesis and double-side finishing; source phase identity is checked against independent characterization, never asserted by name.

branches.title: Register qualified pre-synthesis assignment
branches.design_note: Exact MA-family-to-run parent associations are not established by this source. The three families are inventory dependencies, not proof of actual specimen parentage. A qualified allocation card must bind each run to its true parent.

branches.title: Verify S3630 assembly custody
branches.design_note: Source assembly class 14/8 is metadata only. Resolve foil ambiguity and approve geometry before physical binding; no CAD dimensions or unsafe assembly recipe is supplied.

branches.title: Receive S3630 coupled run records
branches.design_note: Facility owns baseline conditioning, pressure-temperature program and quench. No setpoints or actuation instructions cross the task interface. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Validate phase and length records
branches.design_note: Preserve possible-melt labels, detector calibration and radiographic boundary picks with timestamps and channel provenance.

branches.title: Validate acoustic observations
branches.design_note: S3630/S3565 use a recorded degraded-signal path. Missing shear arrivals stay unavailable, never zero; buffer reverberation cannot be relabelled sample shear.

branches.title: Archive evidence-based onset brackets
branches.design_note: No source solidus is a pass threshold. Keep ambiguous observations and independent channels; the service alone decides physical quench.

branches.title: Receive molybdenum-capsule cross-check
branches.design_note: H5897/H5898 remain two disputed identities. Temperature and texture records must not be merged or swapped to make a coherent-looking result. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Receive graphite-route powder preparation
branches.design_note: This is a powder route; it does not inherit glass, pellet or pre-synthesis history. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Receive S8293 ex situ product
branches.design_note: Temperature channel must be associated with this capsule, run and calibration. Graphite-to-diamond transformation is expected in the paper, not directly proven by that expectation. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Receive H6050 ex situ product
branches.design_note: No thermocouple measurement exists for H6050; a qualified temperature-method record is required and cannot be fabricated. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Receive safe released run products
branches.design_note: No manipulation until the qualified service releases cooled, depressurized, isolated carriers. Failed, damaged and unidentified products go to quarantine with records retained.

branches.title: Track section and mount ancestry
branches.design_note: Destructive sectioning creates children with parent specimen and furnace-axis orientation. Polishing voids and quench cracks remain preparation artifacts, not inferred in-run porosity.

branches.title: Receive registered images and element maps
branches.design_note: Retain S3630 cold and warm regions independently; distinguish central versus buffer-adjacent regions for all specimens. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.

branches.title: Receive spot-level phase chemistry
branches.design_note: Spot replicates are not independent high-pressure runs. S3631 melt chemistry is mass-balance-derived and has no direct spot count or reported spot uncertainty.

branches.title: Preserve two modal-estimation methods
branches.design_note: Pixel-area modes and mass-balance modes retain distinct method, units, region and uncertainty. No silent averaging or converting qualitative literature categories to measurements.

branches.title: Seal specimen and measurement lineage
branches.design_note: Archive identities, raw-record digests, failures, calibration revisions and unresolved conflicts. Completion is evidence integrity, not reproduction of a paper outcome.

branches.title: Review solidus-fit provenance
branches.design_note: Numerical branch only; external low-pressure anchors need their own provenance and uncertainty. No new fit was run.

branches.title: Separate liquid-density model variants
branches.design_note: Keep Asimow model 1 sensitivity, preferred model 2, Wakabayashi-Funamori and Jing-Karato identities separate. No source script was executed.

branches.title: Review residual-solid model inputs
branches.design_note: Residual-solid chemistry must link to its actual run. An SI label cannot prove S3631 provenance when the listed compositions match MA-17.

branches.title: Review undepleted mantle comparator
branches.design_note: Undepleted MA-17 bulk mantle is distinct from coexisting residual solid. Keep thermodynamic and sample identities separate.

branches.title: Register solid-model sensitivity variants
branches.design_note: The excess-volume perturbation acts at solid-solution mixing before aggregate combination; no physical specimen perturbation occurs.

branches.title: Review basal-layer geometry arithmetic
branches.design_note: Preserve inconsistent printed mantle-inner-radius formula, prose and reported output. No corrected formula is silently promoted to author intent.

branches.title: Separate observation from geophysical inference
branches.design_note: Ultrasonic frequencies are not directly seismic frequencies. Martian layer existence, segregation and long-term stability remain interpretations. Melt-bearing redox is qualitatively reducing; the source does not establish a precise quantitative oxygen-fugacity value.
